GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #7 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the gist of the text "Guten Morgen! Ich heiße Neema. Ich bin neun. Auf Wiedersehen!"? (1 mark)
   A. A girl greets, gives her name and age, and says goodbye
   B. A family goes to bed
   C. A boy asks for food
   D. Two friends talk about the weather

2. What does "Guten Tag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. How are you?
   B. good morning
   C. thank you
   D. good day (daytime greeting)

3. You hear: "Das ist mein Vater. Er heißt Juma. Er ist groß." What is the gist? (1 mark)
   A. Someone orders food
   B. Someone talks about the weather
   C. A child describes a sister
   D. A child describes his or her father

4. What does "die Oma" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. parents
   B. son
   C. grandmother
   D. grandfather

5. What does "das Radio" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. window
   B. radio
   C. table
   D. shower

6. What does "die Uhr" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. house
   B. table
   C. cooker
   D. clock

7. Which sentence means "The bed is in the bedroom"? (1 mark)
   A. Das Bett ist im Garten.
   B. Das Bett ist im Schlafzimmer.
   C. Der Tisch ist im Schlafzimmer.
   D. Das Bett ist in der Schlafzimmer.

8. What does "der Mittwoch" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. week
   B. Wednesday
   C. Monday
   D. Saturday

9. Which day is between Montag and Mittwoch? (1 mark)
   A. Dienstag
   B. Freitag
   C. Samstag
   D. Donnerstag

10. Which day comes right after Mittwoch? (1 mark)
   A. Montag
   B. Sonntag
   C. Donnerstag
   D. Freitag

11. What is the "ch" sound like in "Kuchen"? (1 mark)
   A. a breathy sound at the back of the throat
   B. k as in cake
   C. sh as in ship
   D. ts as in cats

12. What number is "achtzehn"? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 18
   C. 14
   D. 8

13. What does "die Bohne" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. bean
   B. supper
   C. meat
   D. onion

14. What does "die Karotte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fish
   B. meat
   C. carrot
   D. juice

15. Which body word contains the letter ß? (1 mark)
   A. Kopf
   B. Fuß
   C. Bein
   D. Hand

16. In the word "Knie", which letters are both said? (1 mark)
   A. k and n
   B. only k
   C. only n
   D. neither

17. Which two words is "Regenbogen" made from? (1 mark)
   A. Regen and Bogen
   B. Wolke and Bogen
   C. Regen and Sonne
   D. Wind and Bogen

18. What does "Es regnet" mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is raining
   B. It is snowing
   C. It is hot
   D. It is windy

19. Which phrase is correct for "in the garden"? (1 mark)
   A. in der Garten
   B. im Garten
   C. in die Garten
   D. an Garten

20. What does "spielen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to play
   B. to help
   C. to hear
   D. to sing

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write the German birthday wish "All the best for your birthday". (2 marks)

22. Explain what it means to listen for the gist of a text. (2 marks)

23. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cake, candle, present. (3 marks)

24. Write the German for: sun, rain, wind, sky. Use der, die or das. (4 marks)

25. Explain how to pronounce ß, sch and z, with one example each. (3 marks)

26. List three members of the wider family in German with their articles. (3 marks)

27. Write the German for: I cook, I sleep, I read, I play. (4 marks)

28. Explain when to use "mein" and when to use "meine". Give one example of each. (3 marks)

29. Say the three time words heute, morgen and gestern in English and give one German sentence with one of them. (3 marks)

30. Write three German sentences that say where things are in a house, using im or in der. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #7 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — A girl greets, gives her name and age, and says goodbye
   The words Guten Morgen, ich heiße, ich bin neun and Auf Wiedersehen show a greeting, a name, an age and a goodbye.

2. D — good day (daytime greeting)
   Guten Tag means good day (daytime greeting).

3. D — A child describes his or her father
   The words Vater, heißt and groß tell us it is about a father.

4. C — grandmother
   die Oma means grandmother.

5. B — radio
   das Radio means radio.

6. D — clock
   die Uhr means clock.

7. B — Das Bett ist im Schlafzimmer.
   Schlafzimmer is a das word, so we use im.

8. B — Wednesday
   der Mittwoch means Wednesday.

9. A — Dienstag
   The order is Montag, Dienstag, Mittwoch.

10. C — Donnerstag
   After Mittwoch comes Donnerstag.

11. A — a breathy sound at the back of the throat
   After u the ch is a scratchy breath sound.

12. B — 18
   achtzehn is the number 18.

13. A — bean
   die Bohne means bean.

14. C — carrot
   die Karotte means carrot.

15. B — Fuß
   Fuß has ß.

16. A — k and n
   In German you say both letters: k-nee.

17. A — Regen and Bogen
   Regen = rain and Bogen = arch or bow: a rainbow.

18. A — It is raining
   regnen is to rain.

19. B — im Garten
   Garten is a der word: in dem = im.

20. A — to play
   spielen means to play.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the words and 1 mark for correct spelling and punctuation.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: It means listening for the main idea, such as who is speaking and what is happening, without needing every word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the main idea, 1 mark for not needing every word.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Kuchen, die Kerze, das Geschenk.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Sonne, der Regen, der Wind, der Himmel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: ß is a strong ss (Fuß). sch is sh (Schulter). z is ts (Zahn).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: die Oma, der Opa, der Onkel, die Tante.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ich koche, ich schlafe, ich lese, ich spiele.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: Use mein with der and das nouns (mein Vater) and meine with die nouns and plurals (meine Mutter).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule and 1 mark for correct examples.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: heute = today, morgen = tomorrow, gestern = yesterday. For example: Heute ist Montag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the three meanings, 1 mark for a correct sentence, 1 mark for capital letters.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das Bett ist im Schlafzimmer. Der Tisch ist in der Küche. Das Sofa ist im Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.
